relations.definition: A structural return from a Claim to one member explicitly declared by its structured-reference-value profile. The complete set and Claim source govern meaning and admission; this edge alone is not accepted membership, equivalence, evidence or a Sign.

labels.ru: имеет гипотезу о мотиве с оговорками

relations.definition: The focal exact Occurrence is the entry to one qualified Claim over all declared member occurrences. The focal is included in the set; no first pair stands for the whole hypothesis, and no member edge independently accepts membership or a Sign.

An attributed rendering judgment about a specified Lexeme, Sense or exact Occurrence in declared source and target contexts. It is not a Sense-to-Sense correspondence, performed translation, search execution or universal impossibility. Competing reports remain separate Claims.

labels.default: is reported as lexically inherited from
labels.en: is reported as lexically inherited from

relations.definition: A reported lexical continuation through the stated language stages, not borrowing, spelling identity or automatic inheritance of every sense. The source is the later lexical referent and the target its proposed predecessor; chronology and evidential limits remain explicit.

A source-qualified lexical borrowing from the target into the subject's usage community. This differs from inheritance, cognacy and an exact translation. Intermediate routes, dates and the extent of semantic transfer remain bounded by the stated evidence.

labels.default: is analyzed as lexically formed from
labels.en: is analyzed as lexically formed from

inverse_labels.default: is a proposed lexical formation base of
inverse_labels.en: is a proposed lexical formation base of

relations.definition: A source-qualified lexical word-formation relationship to a base lexeme, not an inflected written form, record correction or a universal morpheme model. A formation with several lexical bases retains separate Claims and their shared construction account; one base does not prove the complete derivation.

labels.default: is proposed as lexically cognate with
labels.en: is proposed as lexically cognate with

inverse_labels.default: is proposed as lexically cognate with
inverse_labels.en: is proposed as lexically cognate with

relations.definition: A source-qualified common-origin comparison of lexical referents in stated language scopes. It is symmetric but not computationally transitive; spelling resemblance, direct descent, borrowing and a particular immediate ancestor do not follow. Reversing the reading neither creates another Claim nor erases its endpoint scopes.

labels.default: is proposed as historically developed from
labels.en: is proposed as historically developed from

inverse_labels.default: has a proposed later development of sense
inverse_labels.en: has a proposed later development of sense

relations.definition: A proposed historical development from the target's earlier situated lexical reading to the source's later reading. This is not correction of a Sense record, a new spelling, automatic continuity of a philosophical concept or a date inferred from revision time. Narrowing, extension and other mechanisms belong to the stated account and evidence.

labels.default: has a proposed lexical rendering in
labels.en: has a proposed lexical rendering in

inverse_labels.default: is a proposed lexical rendering of
inverse_labels.en: is a proposed lexical rendering of

relations.definition: A directed, source-qualified translation correspondence from one situated lexical reading to another. The scope, preserved aspects and limitations are essential; this does not establish identity, reversibility, full semantic-range equivalence or an accepted translation. Missing or disputed correspondence is not proof of untranslatability.

labels.default: is analyzed as realizing the written form
labels.en: is analyzed as realizing the written form

relations.definition: A source-visible linguistic attribution of this particular use to a written representation in a declared notation scope. A matching label is insufficient; normalization, differing spellings, homographs and competing assignments require their own stated basis.

labels.default: is analyzed as a use of the lexeme
labels.en: is analyzed as a use of the lexeme

relations.definition: A grounded analysis assigning this particular use to a lexical research referent. It is not string identity or automatic lemmatization; other assignments and negative claims may coexist within their scopes.

labels.default: is interpreted with the contextual sense
labels.en: is interpreted with the contextual sense

relations.definition: A qualified reading of the meaning of this particular use, not an assertion that every occurrence of its spelling or lexeme has this sense. Alternative readings, uncertainty and counterevidence remain separate claims.

labels.default: is analyzed as a form of
labels.en: is analyzed as a form of

relations.definition: An evidence-bearing assignment of this written representation to the specified lexeme in a declared linguistic/notation context. Homography, morphology and competing analyses remain possible; neither string equality nor this link proves an occurrence.

labels.default: is proposed as a sense of
labels.en: is proposed as a sense of

relations.definition: A source-qualified placement of a situated reading under this lexeme. This does not make it the only meaning, apply it to every occurrence or turn the reading into a philosophical concept.

labels.default: is assigned to the language or variety
labels.en: is assigned to the language or variety

relations.definition: A source-grounded attribution of a lexical referent to a language or variety within a declared usage and historical scope, not the script or language of its description. Shared spellings and borrowings do not determine this relation automatically.

labels.default: has an inscription attributed to language
labels.en: has an inscription attributed to language

inverse_labels.default: is attributed as inscription language of
inverse_labels.en: is attributed as inscription language of

relations.definition: A scoped attribution of the language of a particular inscription carried by a physical object. It is not the metadata language, exclusive monolinguality, a language/script identity or a verified reading.

labels.default: has an inscription attributed to script
labels.en: has an inscription attributed to script

inverse_labels.default: is attributed as inscription script of
inverse_labels.en: is attributed as inscription script of

relations.definition: A scoped script attribution for an inscription on a carrier. A provider name, language, date or label alone cannot establish it; shared script does not imply shared language.

labels.default: is described as a dialect of
labels.en: is described as a dialect of

relations.definition: A contextual scholarly classification of a variety as a dialect of a linguistic system. Preserve the criterion, source, community and historical scope; no universal mutual-intelligibility rule, transitive closure or ranking is imposed.

labels.default: is described as a historical stage of
labels.en: is described as a historical stage of

relations.definition: A source-grounded account of a variety as a historical stage of a linguistic system. Artifact period is not evidence of this relationship or an inscription's dialect, and historical sequence is not dialect identity.
The source-writing scope represented by a named transliteration convention. It neither executes the convention nor identifies all source-language values.

inverse_labels.default: is used as notation basis by
inverse_labels.en: is used as notation basis by

relations.definition: The target script or writing tradition used as a notation basis by a transliteration convention. Additional signs and conventions remain explicit; target notation is not a translation into the target script's associated language.

A source-bound expressive or documentary form of an intellectual object in the stated context. A letter, lecture, article or aphorism designation is not a MIME type; overlapping genre terms remain facet-specific Claims.

A source-bound carrier classification of a concrete physical artifact or bibliographic item. It describes neither the abstract Work nor a file's MIME type, and alone establishes no preservation, access or use permission.
A source-bound genre classification of an intellectual object with explicit basis and scope. Multiple or competing designations do not change its type, identity, language or formation membership.

A source-bound classification of how this intellectual object is communicated in the stated context. An oral account, written realization or performance does not establish a file format, physical substrate, genre or causal influence.
A source-attributed engagement with the target in a declared receiving context. Reading, agreement, influence and causal dependence are not inferred from one another.

inverse_labels.default: is a target of historical canon formation
inverse_labels.en: is a target of historical canon formation

relations.definition: Identifies material or an author selected as authoritative or exemplary by the stated historical community. It grants no ToS admission, truth, universal status or legal authority.

inverse_labels.default: is a target of scoped forgetting
inverse_labels.en: is a target of scoped forgetting

relations.definition: An attributed decline or interruption in attention or transmission of the target within the stated context. Missing catalog entries or surviving silence alone do not establish total forgetting.
Identifies the target of renewed access or attention for a particular receiving context; not its creation, first discovery by anyone, universal absence or complete textual recovery.
Relates a persisting later configuration to the earlier material or actor to which a source traces it. Transformation, gaps and competing accounts remain; resemblance does not prove direct influence.

Names a work, document, realization, aggregate or physical witness conveying the studied reception. It is distinct from the original target and from evidence supporting this Claim; no textual equivalence or authorship is inferred.
Attributes a modern composite's reconstructive target. The composite is not that intellectual object, an ancient original, an accepted reading or its exact transcription.
Attributes inclusion of a modern scholarly composition in an intellectual container, such as a book. This is content inclusion, not an Edition/Item embodiment or proof of exhaustive coverage.

Attributes inclusion of a particular quoting passage in a scholarly composition. The quoted ancient portion, exact text layer, witness used by an editor and passage's order remain separately asserted.
Attributes the contextual compiler role for a modern scholarly composition. This is not authorship of the ancient reconstructed object, every quoted passage or the containing book.
Attributed membership of the identified textual portion in an intellectual object. Neither complete survival, original boundaries nor exact textual equality follows.
Attributed containing intellectual object of a particular quoting passage, with declared location limits. It does not identify a manuscript, file, original source or a resolved exact-text anchor.

Source-attributed transmission of the identified fragment through this quoting passage. Coverage, wording and attribution limits remain with the Claim; preservation does not establish exact equality, complete survival or authorial authenticity.

An evidence-bound report of textual survival for the stated intellectual-object scope. Complete, fragmentary, not extant and unknown do not change its identity. A surviving quotation or modern reconstruction does not establish complete survival of the original; absence from a reader does not establish loss.
Relates the specified episode, phase or circumstance to the person whose life is studied. It does not assign all participants the same biographical relevance.

inverse_labels.default: is studied within the life phase
inverse_labels.en: is studied within the life phase

relations.definition: A source-grounded placement of an episode within a researched life phase; it does not derive exact time containment or causal order.
A source-attributed assignment to the declared cohort criterion, not organizational membership, unanimity, or proof from birth-year proximity.

labels.default: is studied in the historical period
labels.en: is studied in the historical period

relations.definition: Places a source-described generation in a specific historical periodization; not equality between a cohort and dates or an exact birth range.
Places the specified situation in a researched periodization, not an inferred date, a universal period assignment, or a causal relation.

labels.default: is situated in the described environment
labels.en: is situated in the described environment

relations.definition: A source-grounded contextual association within explicit scope; it implies neither use of available resources, personal adherence, nor causal influence on a person or work.

labels.default: is studied in the described environment
labels.en: is studied in the described environment

relations.definition: Situates a particular conception in a researched historical environment without making the shared concept historical property or inferring causation.

labels.default: is documented during the life phase
labels.en: is documented during the life phase

relations.definition: Associates a life condition with a stated phase under source limits; not a claim that it holds throughout the phase or caused its philosophical content.

Source-attributed intellectual association with this formation in a specified context. It establishes neither social membership, permanent self-identification, endorsement of every view nor causal influence.

labels.default: is a school within the tradition
labels.en: is a school within the tradition

relations.definition: Historically grounded placement of this school within the stated transmission tradition; it does not identify school and tradition or impose exhaustive classification.
Source-grounded intellectual reworking of this tradition by the specified movement. The Claim must describe the reworking; resemblance alone establishes neither transmission nor causality.
A specified work or documentary intellectual object articulates aspects of the formation. This neither makes every sentence a shared doctrine nor identifies the work with its physical carrier.

Source-attributed membership in the specified collective or institution, within its stated membership boundary. It does not establish unanimity, permanent affiliation or membership in a similarly named school.

A source-attributed person-to-person teaching or learning relationship in a stated activity. Reading a person's text alone is not this relationship; shared doctrine and causal influence do not follow.
Source-attributed study at an institution, not necessarily graduation, a qualification, residence or agreement with its teaching.

Source-attributed teaching at an institution within the described field and span. It does not assert employment title, philosophy teaching, educational authority or institutional endorsement of a person's works.
Source-attributed joint activity on the specified undertaking. Co-presence, friendship, co-membership and shared opinions alone do not establish collaboration or equal responsibility.

A source-attributed correspondence relationship, retaining direction, exchange coverage and uncertainty in the statement. A single addressed or unsent letter alone does not establish an exchange, delivery or reading.

A source-attributed friendship, with its reported perspective and temporal scope. The symmetric relational meaning does not prove mutual self-description, agreement, reading or intellectual influence.
A source-attributed conflict on the stated matter. Symmetry of involvement does not assign equal fault, hostility on every issue or permanent opposition.
A described method uses this intellectual action. Order, successful execution and applicability do not follow from membership.

inverse_labels.default: is used in move of thought
inverse_labels.en: is used in move of thought

relations.definition: An intellectual movement uses a specified operation in its declared context; this is neither a deductive-validity verdict nor a software invocation.
A hypothetical inquiry follows the described method without establishing that the method or resulting conclusion is sound.
A thesis is granted for the trial, not asserted as an actual fact or endorsed unconditionally. The scenario and recorded assumptions remain reading context.
A thesis is under examination as a question or potential consequence. Being tested does not mean being accepted, proved or refuted.
An ontological commitment is granted within this hypothetical inquiry. It does not become an unconditional authorial doctrine or a commitment of ToS.
A commitment is attributed to the specified conception with its declared force and scope; neither the researcher nor the core thereby adopts it.
A specified thought object is interpreted through an imaginative or figurative presentation. No literal identity, actual scene or effect on readers is inferred.
A rhetorical figure presents the specified thought in a grounded reading. Formal device, expressed content and actual persuasive effect remain different.
A normative model is interpreted as expressing a particular valuation. This does not claim that the ideal is realized or that ToS endorses the value.
A stance affirms the specified valuation in its source context. Affirmation is attributed, not adopted by the researcher or inferred for every holder.
The method is interpreted as guided by a stated valuation, such as explanatory economy, not by a runtime resource limit or an automatically accepted universal norm.
The source-grounded image presents this conception, including a critical target. Presenting a target does not endorse it or prove the criticism.
A grounded membership under the family's grouping criterion; not identity, exhaustive coverage or inherited answers.
A question articulates a specified problem. Neither its presuppositions nor a solution is thereby accepted.
A thesis is proposed as an answer to this exact question. The connection neither accepts the answer nor declares that every presupposition is justified.
A thesis is attributed to the described stance within explicit scope. A position can change historically only through separately grounded accounts; revising its description is not that change.
A stance addresses the specified difficulty without implying that it solves it or that all authors recognize the same problem.
A specified perspective is used to examine this conception. The aspect is not a new copy of the conception or an automatic property of other conceptions.
A grounded connection from a perspective to its crosscutting subject. It neither imposes one definition nor infers membership of every conception.
An organizing relation in the specified inquiry, not an assertion that the concept instantiates a technical runtime type.
First term is a contextual role in this distinction, not temporal priority, superiority or a new intrinsic type. The source criterion explains the differentiation.
Second term is a contextual role in this distinction, not temporal succession, inferiority or a new intrinsic type. Missing or competing term claims remain explicit incompleteness.

Assigns an inference step a declared position in this argument reconstruction. Position is local to the claim context; partial and competing reconstructions remain possible. Neither sequence, logical validity nor chronological occurrence is inferred.

inverse_labels.default: is used as a premise in
inverse_labels.en: is used as a premise in

relations.definition: Assigns a thesis the premise role in this particular inference step. The same thesis may have another role elsewhere, or be granted hypothetically without endorsement. Its truth is not entailed.

Assigns a thesis the conclusion role in this step. This records the reconstructed reasoning, not proof that the conclusion follows or is true. Multiple conclusions or rival reconstructions need not be collapsed.

An interpretation that this thesis belongs to the situated conception within the declared scope. Membership is neither truth, exhaustive coverage nor universal commitment of everyone associated with the conception.

inverse_labels.default: has an argument offered in support
inverse_labels.en: has an argument offered in support

relations.definition: Identifies what an argument is offered to support, not whether it succeeds. The relation is distinct from a conclusion's local role in an inference step.
Targets the specific inferential transition, not automatically the truth of its premises or rejection of the whole argument. The challenge account and relation basis state the contested feature.
Targets this proposition or its conditions as explicitly explained in the relation basis. A challenge is not a proof of negation; a premise may be challenged separately from the transition using it.
Targets the identified reasoning structure as a whole under the declared scope. Use objection_to_step for a specific transition; this relation does not silently manufacture targets for every part.
Targets specified commitments of a situated conception, not a shared concept, the existence of its thinker or all associated theses.
Relates a substantive challenge to reasoning offered to develop it. The two referents remain distinct; neither mutual support nor a cycle in discussion proves circular reasoning or validity.

An evidence-bearing interpretation linking a specified thought object to an intellectual or textual object. This is not an exact occurrence anchor, authorship, literal quotation, complete coverage or endorsement.

A scoped attribution of a thought object to an individual or collective, distinct from the maker of this research Claim. A premise granted for reductio is not automatically endorsed, and attribution need not be exclusive.

A grounded membership assertion explaining which continuity criterion and shared problem connects this particular conception to this crosscutting concept. Shared spelling, translation or topic labels alone do not suffice. Multiple competing memberships and explicit denials may coexist; membership asserts neither identical definitions nor canonical acceptance.

labels.default: is attributed as a conception to
labels.en: is attributed as a conception to

relations.definition: An attribution of this situated account to a responsibility bearer or collective, within the Claim's declared scope. The maker of the attribution is separate from the attributed thinker; attribution does not establish endorsement of every quoted statement or exclusive authorship.

inverse_labels.default: is interpreted as expressing a conception
inverse_labels.en: is interpreted as expressing a conception

relations.definition: An evidence-bearing interpretation that a specified intellectual or textual object expresses this conception. Expression is not authorship, complete coverage, acceptance, identical wording, or an unqualified statement by the object creator.

The subject conception gives a materially changed definition of the object conception's problem or commitments. The Claim explains retained and changed features; similarity, chronology, record correction, translation and direct influence are not entailed.

The subject conception rejects specified commitments of the object conception. The Claim identifies the rejected content and its scope; polemic is not total contradiction, psychological hostility, or rejection of the shared concept.

The subject conception restricts the object conception's declared scope or application. The Claim identifies the comparison dimension and boundary; graph subset, later chronology and a shorter description do not establish this relation.

The subject conception extends the object conception's declared scope or application. The Claim identifies the comparison dimension and added scope; additional text or graph neighbors alone do not establish expansion.

The subject conception reworks specified religious or theological commitments of the object conception in a declared non-theological register. The Claim states which commitments and comparison justify the description; neither progress nor total removal of religious meaning is entailed.

The subject conception reworks specified features of the object conception in terms of mental processes or psychological explanation. The Claim names those features and grounds; this relation neither diagnoses a person nor establishes causal influence.

The subject conception reworks specified features of the object conception in a political scope of power, institutions or collective action. The Claim states its comparison and grounds; mere political context is insufficient.

The subject conception reverses a specified ordering, valuation, opposition or explanatory direction of the object conception. The Claim names what is reversed; visual direction, logical negation, reciprocal relations or record version order alone do not establish inversion.

A source claim about who sends or purports to send a letter. Sender is not automatically author, copyist, printer or the person who physically carries it; an addressed draft need not have been dispatched.
A source claim identifying the intended addressee of correspondence. Addressing does not establish delivery, actual reading, agreement, intellectual influence or authorship.

An evidence-bound attribution of a document to a persistent physical artifact. It does not equate the intellectual document with its carrier or guarantee autograph status, complete preservation, textual equivalence, custody or reuse rights. Different copies may be different carriers.

A claim linking a historical situation with a document relevant to its reconstruction. The evidence must explain the association; mere proximity, a shared date or a title does not establish participation, chronology, causation or source independence.

inverse_labels.default: is identified as subject of document
inverse_labels.en: is identified as subject of document

relations.definition: A source-attributed claim that a document concerns a Work, including scholarly identification when the document does not name the work explicitly. It is not necessarily a verbatim mention, quotation, authorship attribution or historical influence.

inverse_labels.default: is time anchor for dating claim
inverse_labels.en: is time anchor for dating claim

relations.definition: A relative dating Claim explicitly names this historical situation as its temporal anchor. The original before, after, during or overlaps qualifier remains in the date value. The edge alone asserts no chronology and implies no absolute date or causal influence.

An evidence-bound dating of a historical situation, distinct from witness creation, data capture and knowledge revision. Exact, approximate, disputed, unknown and relative dates do not imply one another. Competing datings remain separate Claims; numerical comparison never accepts the assertion.

A claim assigning an Agent or Organization to a historical situation with an explicit contextual participation role. Presence, authorship, responsibility and causal influence are not implied by one another.
A claim relating a historical situation to a normalized Place in its stated spatial and temporal scope. It does not assert political belonging, permanent residence or causal influence.
A source-owned topical association of a historical situation with a Work. Creation, publication, reading, reception and influence remain more specific claims; this relation implies none of them.
Stand-off has_text_layer link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off has_annotation link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off anchored_in link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off has_text_unit link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off has_anchor link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off annotation_member link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off assertion_subject link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off assertion_object link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off assertion_evidence link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off assertion_review link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Stand-off asserted_by link explicitly present in the source packet. It records structure, not acceptance of the associated interpretation.
Root of the semantic interchange relation hierarchy; it does not erase source-native predicates.
Explicit fallback for a source-native predicate that has no reviewed semantic interchange mapping yet.
Stable interchange family for source-native conceptual predicates; predicate_id preserves the exact authored relation such as develops_concept or influences.

source_mappings.definition: Source-declared genre classification; neither identity nor authorship.
Source-declared development of the target concept; the source review posture remains authoritative.
A directional influence claim, not equivalence, necessary causation, or an automatically transitive relation.
Source-declared polemical engagement; it neither establishes influence nor requires reciprocal engagement.
Source-declared conceptual transformation; the target is not thereby identical to the source.

relations.definition: Stable interchange family for historical placement while retaining the exact source-native predicate_id.
Stable interchange family for transmission, commentary, translation, preservation and survival predicates without collapsing their source-native identity.
Stable interchange family for contestation and explicitly uncertain source relations; it never upgrades them to accepted truth.
Stable interchange family for declared language and script use; exact predicate_id distinguishes language from script.
Derived workbench relation that counts requested node or relation vocabulary; it is not a philosophical assertion.
Derived atlas and workbench containment or preparation route; it carries navigation, not philosophical truth.

labels.default: links to an access or description surface
labels.ru: связывает с поверхностью доступа или описания
labels.en: links to an access or description surface

relations.definition: Connects a source object to a declared Link identity; predicate_id retains whether the link describes, supplies metadata, states rights, or permits download.
Stable interchange family for the bounded relation vocabulary embedded directly in authored ToS node contracts; predicate_id preserves the exact subtype.
Stable interchange family for predicates owned by the ToS canon predicate registry; predicate_id preserves the exact registered subtype and its source authority.
Root for source-tree and repository topology relations that do not assert philosophical meaning.
Contains another navigation or repository projection object; it is not geographic containment.
Connects a repository branch projection to its indexed manifest representation.
Connects a repository branch projection to an indexed resource representation.
Connects a philosophy branch route to an authored source-planting record.
Connects one source planting to its declared witness backlog anchor without asserting canon.
Connects two carrier representations that declare the same persistent ToS entity identity; it is not a new same-as judgment.
Inverse vocabulary entry for tos.relation.projects; stored graph edges remain in the projects direction.
Root for evidence-bearing Work, Expression, Edition, Collection, Item and File topology predicates.
Relates a Work to an Expression through an evidence-bearing claim.
Relates an Expression to an Edition without implying textual equivalence.
Relates an Edition to one acquired Item through an evidence-bearing claim.
Connects one Item to an immutable content-addressed File from its manifest.
Relates a Collection to a member Work through an evidence-bearing membership claim.
A directed non-transitive Expression derivation claim that does not establish equivalence.
Root for role-specific responsibility claims; roles are relations, not Agent subclasses.

Relates a Work or Document to the Agent carrying the author role through a claim. Authorship is distinct from sending, addressing, copying or owning its carrier; competing attributions remain separate Claims.
Relates an Expression to the Agent carrying the translator role through a claim.
Relates an intellectual object to the Agent carrying an editor role through a claim.
Relates an intellectual object to the Agent responsible for an afterword.
Relates an intellectual object to a role-bearing contributor when a narrower responsibility predicate is unavailable.
Relates an intellectual object to the Agent carrying a design responsibility role.
Root for reified claim, evidence, maker, provenance and review edges.
Connects a reified Claim to its subject representation.
Connects a reified Claim to its identity or literal object representation.
Connects a reified Claim to one source-returnable Evidence object.
Connects a reified Claim to its recorded maker representation.
Connects a reified Claim to the provenance event that generated its recorded form.
Connects a claim to a normalized Place while preserving literal form and spatial role separately.
Connects a claim to a normalized Agent or Organization while preserving the role separately.
Relates a Work to a claim-scoped chronology with explicit interval, stages, precision and ordering warning.
Relates an Edition to a claim-scoped provision activity with typed roles, places and temporal assertion.
Generic claim predicate for a named temporal facet that is not first-publication chronology.
Root for explicit semantic handoffs between source, claim, canon and projection layers.
States that one explicit representation stands for another identified object under a source-owned assertion.
Connects a semantic object or claim to the exact source identity or evidence that grounds it.
A source-owned topical relation that must not be inferred from labels or text similarity alone.
A reviewed identity-equivalence assertion; shared labels, paths or similar text never create it automatically.
